newsitem.title: CHILE: Ten people presumed dead in Chile forest fires.
newsitem.headline: Ten people presumed dead in Chile forest fires.

text.p: Ten people were believed killed and dozens of houses were gutted by forest fires that swept through the countryside near the port of Concepcion in southern Chile, said La Tercera on Sunday.
The fires destroyed 30 houses, damaged three schools and caused the evacuation of more than 300 people, many from the poor agricultural village of Menque.
"It is most likely that they have died, as the flames have destroyed everything," police lieutenant Salomon Zenteno told the paper, referring to 10 villagers unaccounted for.
"In these circumstances the only thing we can do is try to control the fire and then look for the people who have disappeared."

The missing were last seen by relatives rescuing possessions from their houses. Two farmers believed to have caused the blazes by lighting illegal bush fires that spread out of control have been arrested, officials said.
The victims were men and women aged 38-65 who lived in several small farming communities, police said.
